claim_boundary: This ledger preregisters a Claude-only post-hoc confirmation of five findings from the completed v8 FAIL and four defect classes closed after that archive by internal adversarial review. Its packet is scoped to the seven surfaces these targets name, so any result it authorizes is bounded to those surfaces. It does not rewrite v8, does not count anything under the never-run v9, does not establish unbiased discovery, does not prove the remediations before the v10 calls, does not provide cross-provider evidence, does not cover product surfaces outside those seven, and does not enter the model packet or prompt.
packet_scope_policy: The frozen v10 packet contains exactly the seven surfaces named across these targets' affected_files, and nothing else. Two structural gates run before any model call and both fail closed: every file named in affected_files must be a packet surface, so each bound target can actually be reopened by a valid finding; and no packet surface may be uncited by a bound target, so the reviewed scope cannot grow wider than the scope this ledger binds. The packet was reduced to these seven surfaces before freeze because the earlier 33-surface packet rendered an 877,407-byte prompt that claude-opus-5 rejects for length, which this protocol maps to INCONCLUSIVE. A not-reopened result is therefore evidence about these seven surfaces only, and about no surface the pre-reduction packet carried and this one drops. Where a bound class is implemented in a helper module that is not itself a packet surface, the helper is named in implementation_outside_packet, and the not-reopened result for that target is evidence about the included call sites and contracts only, not about the helper's internals.
provenance_policy: Targets whose evidence_provenance is observed-by-v8-model-attempt were raised by a model attempt in the completed v8 archive. Targets whose evidence_provenance is closed-by-internal-adversarial-review-after-v8-archive were found and closed by the authors' own adversarial re-review after v8 and were never observed by any model attempt in any archived phase, so their observed_attempt_ids list is empty and no independent discovery is claimed for them.
source_binding_policy: The nine target identities and the immutable v8 evidence are fixed here. Product source bytes and verification receipts are captured by the one canonical v10 source snapshot and freeze immediately before the calls; this ledger intentionally does not pin intermediate source hashes.

targets.historical_title: Artifact reader uses ambient Python resolution
targets.required_remediation: Prescribe a bundled launcher that binds and validates an absolute non-project Python interpreter under an isolated environment, with the same boundary for Cypress readers.
Run independent residual credential detectors over emitted strings after redaction and fail when any supported credential shape remains.

targets.historical_title: UTF-8 frame length uses character count
targets.required_remediation: Compute and emit UTF-8 byte length and use the same framing helper for preflight and raw-ARIA requests.
Apply the foreign-test-module exclusion before Cypress basename admission unless executable Cypress provenance is present.

targets.historical_title: Opt-in ESLint plugins are not version-bounded
targets.required_remediation: Pin explicit reviewed versions for every opt-in downloaded ESLint package and update them only through a deliberate release change.

targets.historical_title: Reviewer scanner scope and provenance checks could silently drop every finding
targets.required_remediation: Keep the Cypress provenance check multi-line aware, distinguish runtime value imports from type-only imports that are erased at runtime before applying the foreign-test-module exclusion, and evaluate JavaScript escape sequences in module specifiers through one shared lexer used by every detector, so that a single erased import or escaped specifier cannot clear a genuine spec or degrade a gating finding to non-gating triage.

targets.historical_title: Residual credential gate missed keyword, separator and value-extent variants
targets.required_remediation: Keep the residual gate a marker invariant rather than a value parser: for every sensitivity keyword followed by an assignment separator the next token must be the redaction marker, the gate's separator alphabet must remain a superset of the redactor's, and any separator the redactor does not handle must fail closed instead of emitting. Keep the accepted cost stated in the module.

targets.historical_title: Artifact readers could execute a target-project interpreter
targets.required_remediation: Keep both bundled launchers resolving only an absolute non-project CPython from a bounded candidate list, rejecting relative, symlinked, target-cwd and environment-supplied interpreters, and executing the reader with an isolated interpreter environment.

targets.historical_title: Opt-in lint and AST tooling was not version-bounded or shim-safe
targets.required_remediation: Keep every opt-in downloaded package pinned to an exact reviewed version, including the ast-grep CLI alongside ESLint, its parser and the framework plugins; keep downloads behind explicit opt-in with a minimized environment; keep rejecting target-project ast-grep and sg shims; and update pins only through a deliberate release change.
